Last updated: 07/11/2026.

## What we use
This website uses **only strictly necessary technical tools**, which do not require consent (Art. 122 Italian Privacy Code and Garante guidelines of 10 June 2021; ePrivacy Directive Art. 5(3)). **We do not use profiling, analytics, advertising or social cookies.**

- **Browser local storage «gdr_note»**: remembers that you dismissed the information notice. Duration: until manually cleared.
- **Browser local storage «gdr_map»**: remembers that you agreed to load the OpenStreetMap map. Duration: until manually cleared.
- **Session cookie «gdr_admin»**: used only in the operator's private area (CMS) after login; it is not set for visitors.

## Third-party content
The OpenStreetMap map is loaded only if you click «Load the map». In that case OpenStreetMap may log your IP and use its own cookies/technologies, as described in its policy (osmfoundation.org/wiki/Privacy_Policy).

## How to manage or delete
You can clear local storage and cookies in your browser settings; to withdraw map consent just clear the site's data.
